name: Azeroth Companion
title: LIVING INTELLIGENCE — Atlas Coordinates, Blizzard Gear Intelligence & Adventure Director
approval_note: Owner approved the next development milestone focused on three useful tools: zone map coordinates, explicit public Blizzard research snapshots and manual adventure preparation. Real-world and iPhone device validation remain pending.
features: World Atlas now has a 0–100 zone coordinate laboratory with seven referenced in-game UI Map IDs, 6 themed pin types, personal notes, user-supplied session-only zone map image preview, copyable in-game waypoint macros and safe portable JSON waypoint library.
The illustrated continent map remains artistic; it does not pretend to provide official Blizzard zone tiles or auto-detected character location. No images uploaded or map tiles scraped.

Character Intelligence expands existing public Blizzard profile/gear fetches into transparent, detailed slot-level and item-level research with explicitly saved, dated reports. The Character Nexus and Adventure Director can read those saved public research snapshots later.

New Living Intelligence Director turns saved manual Atlas missions, existing Adventure Operations time estimates and optional saved gear research into a personalized 30-minute to four-hour suggested agenda with character filters, sourced preparation links, checklists and exportable briefing.
New v22 waypoint, gear snapshot and director preference keys are isolated from original saves; Save Protection exports them but never includes AES-encrypted private Vault videos or keys.

NEXUS Command navigation, native Command Center search, PROXIMUS Gateway and PWA shortcuts now include Living Intelligence; all existing talent, maps, media, account verification, music and private Vault features remain unchanged.

Dedicated source-level and synthetic desktop Chromium/iPhone WebKit tests cover correct user-entered coordinates, safe public API capture, planning algorithms, data isolation and mobile accessibility.
